channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Laois hurling hero Dunphy calls it a day
item.description: Laois hurling star Willie Dunphy has brought the curtain down on his stellar 14-year inter-county career.

item.title: Dingle hoping to have O'Connor for final
item.description: Dingle manager Padraig Corcoran is hopeful that Aussie Rules star Mark O'Connor will be available for Sunday week's All-Ireland club SFC final against St Brigid's at Croke Park.

item.title: St Brigid's eye final redemption
item.description: Anthony Cunningham is hoping the memories of St Brigid's heartbreaking 2024 All-Ireland club SFC final loss to Glen will drive them to victory in this year's decider against Dingle.

item.title: Cats criticised for refusing to play Walsh Cup game
item.description: Westmeath GAA has issued a statement in which it hits out at Kilkenny for their "clear refusal to play a properly scheduled and authorised fixture".

item.title: Former Kildare star Sweeney takes charge of Portarlington
item.description: Laois senior football kingpins Portarlington have appointed Ronan Sweeney as their new manager.

item.title: Down GAA mourns Paul Doran
item.description: Down GAA has paid a heartfelt tribute to the late Paul Doran, who was well-known to supporters through his work for Down GAA TV.

item.title: Geaney and Dingle ready to fulfil Croker dream
item.description: Reaching the All-Ireland club SFC final was something Dingle had been plotting since 2018, according to captain Paul Geaney.

item.title: Kerry include All-Ireland winning quartet for season opener
item.description: The Kerry team to face Clare in this evening's McGrath Cup opener at Clarecastle includes four players who featured in last year's All-Ireland SFC final victory over Donegal.

item.title: St Brigid's sweating on injured duo
item.description: Brian Stack and Mark Daly are facing a race against time to be fit for St Brigid's All-Ireland club SFC final showdown with Dingle on Sunday week.

item.title: DCU open Sigerson Cup defence against Ulster University
item.description: The 2026 Sigerson Cup gets underway today with four first round ties down for decision.
